Vin diesel post credits sequences expanded:
Beat 1 – The Step
Soft sound.
Boot on metal.
Not described.
Just presence.

Beat 2 – Recognition
Gravel voice.
Calm. No drama.
"We thought growing family was all that mattered."
Pause.
Audience laughs slightly in recognition.

Beat 3 – Reframe
"Didn't stop to think who we were burnin' to do it."
Silence.
The word "family" flips meaning in real time.

Beat 4 – Moral Compression
"Family ain't who you stack on top of the fire."
Beat.
"It's who you leave room for when the light starts runnin' out."
No swelling score.
Just sincerity.
